title: Work we take on
description: Say plainly what you do and what you do not. A page that is specific about the work wins the right enquiries and saves everyone a call.

title: How we work
description: The shape of a project from first conversation to handover, so someone can picture working with you before they write.

title: What it costs
description: A range, a day rate or a starting figure. Being open about money is the fastest way to find the people you can actually help.

title: Who it is for
description: The kind of client or customer you serve best. Name them and they will recognise themselves.

title: Proof
description: Past work, the results it had, and a word from someone you did it for. One real example beats a page of claims.

title: How to reach us
description: One obvious way to get in touch, and how long a reply takes. Everything above exists to get someone here.
